description: Canonical lifecycle envelope for every Claude / Codex task consumed by the V2 closed-loop execution engine. The engine refuses to operate on descriptors that fail this contract.

task_id.description: Stable opaque id; filename-derived if absent.

file_lock_group.description: All tasks sharing this key serialize their edits; the runner refuses parallel execution of the same lock group.

pid_or_job_id.description: Real OS process id or supervisor job id while running. Engine refuses to mark active without this.

log_path.description: Path to the per-task log under claude_worklog/final_readiness/v2_closed_loop_execution/latest/logs/.

expected_output_paths.description: Paths the runner watches to confirm completion (GO_NO_GO, CODEX_REVIEW, etc.).

codex_pair_task_id.description: For CLAUDE_IMPLEMENTATION tasks, the paired Codex review task id; for CODEX_REVIEW, the Claude task it reviews.

stall_count.description: Number of times the engine relaunched this task after stall.

max_stall_relaunches.description: Engine relaunches once; on second stall it escalates per spec.

duplicate_suppression_key.description: If two pending tasks share this key, the second is marked duplicate_suppressed.

ready_invariants: active_lane_count is computed from real running pid_or_job_id values, never from descriptors alone
duplicate_suppression_key collisions never produce two simultaneously running tasks
file_lock_group collisions never produce two simultaneously running tasks
stall_count is monotonically non-decreasing and never exceeds max_stall_relaunches without a takeover or remediation descriptor being created
CLAUDE_EXECUTOR_NOT_AVAILABLE_OPERATOR_ACTION_REQUIRED, when emitted, blocks the ready marker
